blocks.text: The Miss International pageant is one of the competitions where avid fans believe a candidate of a certain archetype (erroneously referred to by many as “prototype”) has a favorable shot at the crown. But Philippine delegate Katrina Anne Johnson said she believes otherwise. For a lot of pageant fans, the Japan-based international pageant almost always crowns women who look like “Barbie dolls,” with gentle demeanor, and have somewhat of a subdued stage performance. The Binibining Pilipinas titleholder offered to dispute such observation. In her four years with the national pageant (as a candidate in 2023, a reigning runner-up in 2024, a […]...
